findings.title: Majority of Java source files missing from graph
findings.detail: Only 164 of 882 Java source files on disk (18.6%) are properly represented. 718 files are completely absent. The missing files span all major subdirectories: FrontElements (386), CircuitElements (313), tools (16), Drivers (2), MyParser (1). This suggests the scanning or batching phase did not cover the full project.
findings.suggestedFix: Verify the file discovery and batching step covers all source directories. Check scan-result.json and batch configuration for exclusion patterns that may have filtered out these files. Re-run the scanning phase with a broader include pattern.

findings.title: 162 nodes still use file:// prefix instead of file:
findings.detail: The merge script claimed to normalize file:// to file: prefix, but 162 file-type nodes still have IDs starting with file:// (e.g., file://CircuitElements/Boolean/DigitalCircuitSim/src/DigitalCircuitSim.java). These coexist with 876 properly-formed file: prefixed nodes.
findings.affects: All queries filtering by ID prefix will miss these nodes
findings.suggestedFix: Run a post-processing step: replace 'file://' with 'file:' in all node IDs and update edge source/target references accordingly.

findings.title: 19 class nodes have broken IDs after file:// cleanup
findings.detail: 19 nodes have IDs like class://DigitalCircuitSim or class://MyTableEditor. The file:// prefix was stripped but the path separator was lost, producing class://ClassName instead of class:path/to/File.java:ClassName. This breaks the connection between classes and their source files.
findings.affects: class://DigitalCircuitSim, class://MyTableEditor, class://BooleanModel, class://Demultiplexer, class://Multiplexer, and 14 others
findings.suggestedFix: These originated from the 162 file:// nodes. After fixing the file:// prefix, regenerate class/function nodes for those source files to recover proper IDs.

findings.title: 284 file paths in graph do not correspond to files on disk
findings.detail: 284 file paths extracted from node IDs do not resolve to any file under the project root. Combined with the 25 absolute macOS paths and 25 bare filenames (no directory), this means 334 of 498 extracted .java paths (67%) cannot be verified against the actual project structure.
findings.affects: Graph integrity; any tool traversing from edge references to actual files will fail
findings.suggestedFix: Normalize all paths relative to the project root. Strip absolute prefixes (/Users/...), remove leading /, and ensure consistent file: prefix handling. Verify paths exist before including nodes.

findings.title: 361 function nodes include Java method signatures in IDs
findings.detail: Function IDs contain full parameter type information (e.g., function://DigitalCircuitSim.parseString(String,boolean[]), function:__nofilepath__:method:Color.ColorConst.ColorConst.paint(Graphics g)). This conflicts with the convention used for the 1244 other function nodes which use the simpler function:path:methodName format.
findings.affects: 361 function nodes from files with file:// prefix or __nofilepath__
findings.suggestedFix: Strip parameter signatures from function IDs. Store signature info in a 'signature' or 'properties' field instead of embedding it in the ID.

findings.title: 241 function nodes use __nofilepath__ placeholder
findings.detail: 241 function nodes have IDs like function:__nofilepath__:method:Color.ColorConst.ColorConst.paint(Graphics g) where the source file path could not be determined. These cannot be traced back to any source file.
findings.affects: 241 function nodes, including self-loop edges referencing __nofilepath__ functions
findings.suggestedFix: Identify the source files for these functions and correct their IDs. If the source is external (e.g., from a library JAR), mark them as 'external' type instead.

findings.title: 25 absolute macOS file paths in node IDs
findings.detail: 25 nodes use absolute paths like file:/Users/xuyi/Source/Java/myopenlab/distribution/Elements/FrontElements/Drivers/Robotic_2WD/src/Servo.java instead of relative paths.
findings.affects: Portability; graph will break on other machines
findings.suggestedFix: Strip the project root prefix from all absolute paths to make them relative.

findings.title: 25 bare filenames without directory context
findings.detail: 25 nodes have IDs like file:HexToBytes.java, file:ButtonAction.java, etc. with no directory path, making it impossible to locate the actual file or avoid name collisions.
findings.suggestedFix: Determine the full relative path for these files. If they come from a classpath/library dependency, mark them as external type.

findings.title: Inconsistent ID namespace conventions
findings.detail: The file: prefix is overloaded for multiple subtypes: file:pkg: (library), file:infra:, file:error:, file:import:, file:field:, file:method:, file:java_file:, file:java_class:, file:missing:, file:external:. While functional, this makes it harder to query nodes by type. Other types (class:, function:, config:, document:, module:) use their own top-level prefix consistently.
findings.suggestedFix: Consider using the node 'type' field for classification and keeping the ID prefix as a simple indicator (file:, class:, function:). Or conversely, use dedicated prefixes for each subtype.

findings.title: 22 self-loop edges (source == target)
findings.detail: 22 edges have identical source and target IDs, including 5 from  __nofilepath__ functions and some from properly-identified functions like Parser.calc. Self-loops are typically a noise artifact in call-graph analysis.
findings.affects: 22 edges that carry no useful relationship information
findings.suggestedFix: Filter out self-loop edges during assembly, or at least verify they represent legitimate recursive calls. If recursive, add a 'recursive' flag.

findings.title: 21 calls edges target file-type nodes instead of functions
findings.detail: 21 edges of type 'calls' have a target node of type 'file' (e.g., calls to MyStreamTokenizer.java, Compiler.java, Node.java). Calls should reference the class or function within the file, not the file itself.
findings.affects: 21 edges primarily in VirtualMachines/ subdirectory (ArduinoCompiler, ATmegaCompiler, PIC_16F877_Compiler)
findings.suggestedFix: If the called function/class is not analyzed, either target the class node (if it exists) or use a coarser edge type like 'references' or 'depends_on'.

findings.title: 14 inherits edges target non-class nodes (type=code)
findings.detail: 14 inherits edges have targets typed as 'code' rather than 'class' (e.g., TasterPanel -> JVSMain, Anzeige -> JVSMain). These likely reference superclass relationships but the JVSMain/Component nodes were classified as code instead of class/external_class.
findings.affects: Inheritance hierarchy analysis will miss these relationships
findings.suggestedFix: If the superclass is external (from a framework/library), set its type to 'external_class'. If it's a code node within the project, reclassify it to 'class'.

findings.title: 2422 nodes (81%) lack summary field
findings.detail: 2422 of 2981 nodes have no 'summary' text. The 559 nodes with summaries are primarily config, document, module, infra, library, and root file nodes. Most class (321/321), function (1605/1605), code (154/154), java_function (105/105), and file (499/499) nodes are missing summaries.
findings.suggestedFix: Generate summaries for all nodes. For file nodes, derive from file structure. For class/function nodes, use docstrings or LLM-generated descriptions.

findings.title: 626 nodes lack name field
findings.detail: 626 nodes do not have a 'name' property. These include all 162 file:// prefixed nodes and their derived class/function nodes. Name is essential for display and identification.
findings.affects: Graph display and querying by name
findings.suggestedFix: Populate name from the filename for file nodes, class name for class nodes, and method name for function nodes.

findings.title: 10 related edges have vague semantics
findings.detail: 10 edges with type 'related' (plus 4 'documents' and 2 'configures') exist between config/document nodes. These are few in number and structurally valid but the 'related' type is underspecified.
findings.suggestedFix: Consider whether 'related' edges could be replaced with more specific types (references, depends_on, describes, etc.) or kept as a catch-all.

findings.title: Duplicate node names across different directories
findings.detail: Multiple Java files share the same filename across different directories (e.g., Abfrage.java, AND.java, Compiler.java, Element.java, Node.java, among others). Since class and function IDs incorporate the full path, this is handled correctly for properly-formed IDs, but the 25 bare-filename nodes lose this disambiguation.
findings.suggestedFix: Ensure all nodes use fully-qualified relative paths. See finding on bare filenames.

positive_aspects: No dangling edge references — all 3,629 edge sources and targets reference existing node IDs
No duplicate node IDs — all 2,981 IDs are unique
No duplicate edges — all 3,629 edges are unique (source + target + type tuples)
Edge type taxonomy is reasonable: contains (2,249), imports (942), calls (246), inherits (167), implements (9), related (10), documents (4), configures (2)
Config, document, and module nodes are well-formed with complete summaries and consistent IDs
The 499 properly-formed file-type nodes and their 321 class + 1244 function child nodes form a consistent hierarchy with correct contains, imports, and inherits edges
Imports edges correctly reference library, package, and dependency target nodes
recommendations: 1. Fix file:// → file: prefix normalization (162 nodes, affects derived class/function nodes)
2. Re-generate class and function nodes for the 162 affected source files to fix class:// and function:// malformed IDs
3. Strip absolute macOS path prefix from 25 nodes to make graph portable
4. Resolve 284 non-matching file paths — either fix path format or add the files on disk
5. Remove parameter signatures from 361 function IDs; store in a properties field instead
6. Identify and fix the 241 __nofilepath__ function nodes or classify them as external
7. Investigate why 718 Java source files (81%) were not included in the scan — check scan/batch configuration
8. Add name field to 626 missing nodes
9. Add summary field to all nodes for better graph discoverability
10. Filter out self-loop edges or mark them explicitly as recursive
